profile.name: Kamal Raj Sekar
profile.tagline: 2x failed AI SaaS Maker | Published Author | Speaker | XP | Devops Coach | Open-source Contributor | Software Architect | Hands-on Techie

summary:
I help organizations become technically agile and leverage AI throughout their engineering processes.

With 15+ years of hands-on experience, I work with teams to adopt practices like Test-Driven Development, Extreme Programming, and DevOps, not just as buzzwords, but as real, sustainable ways of working.

I've co-created AI products (FaceQuest and Notesally), authored books on Test-Driven Development and AI-augmented software development, and written white paper 'Real Productivity, Rare Pushbacks' on AI agents. I've worked with companies ranging from startups to Fortune 500s. My focus is simple: help teams ship quality software, using both proven engineering practices and modern AI tools where they actually make sense.

experience.details:
Authored the whitepaper *“Real Productivity, Rare Pushbacks”*, outlining a strategic framework for integrating AI agents into product development to boost team efficiency and reduce resistance.

Built the MVPs for two AI SaaS products:
- **FaceQuest** – AI-powered facial recognition platform supporting both 1:1 face verification and 1:N face search.
- **Notesally** – AI assistant to enhance sales productivity and improve CRM data quality through intelligent note management.
highlights: FaceQuest – AI-powered facial recognition platform supporting both 1:1 face verification and 1:N face search.
Notesally – AI assistant to enhance sales productivity and improve CRM data quality through intelligent note management.
